beats.say: 1,479 horsepower: The Bugatti Chiron runs a monster engine.
That is enough power to make the car feel like a jet plane on the highway.
The heart of the beast is a 7,993 cc quad-turbocharged W16 engine.
Such a huge engine creates massive amounts of heat that must be managed.
To cope, the Chiron uses ten separate radiators to keep the engine cool.
This setup allows the car to accelerate from 0 to 100 km/h in just 2.4 seconds.
It can even reach 400 km/h in 32.6 seconds, a feat of engineering.
That was On the Road; subscribe so you don't miss the next one.

facts: The Bugatti Chiron is powered by a 7,993 cc quad-turbocharged W16 engine.
The engine produces a peak power output of 1,479 hp.
The Chiron can accelerate from 0 to 100 km/h in 2.4 seconds.
The Chiron reached 400 km/h in 32.6 seconds during a 2017 test.
